quests.title: Four Minutes at Clarendon
quests.blurb: Nobody upstairs believes me about Clarendon because I have 31 years and no data. Go and stand on that platform on a wet Monday and get me the data, and they keep sending a different bloke.

photograph the board saying four minutes
ride the one that finally comes
give me the number

quests.title: Possession at Chatswood

steps.label: where they come through the fence

come back and tell me straight

the two arguing over the grass

steps.label: up the hill, the way the road does not go
the view I have never stopped for

quests.title: The Strip Outside The Star
quests.blurb: A metre of dirt between the fence and the footpath at The Star, dead for 11 years and not dead now. Council mows on the fifteenth and does not know what is in it. Stand near it and stop the man with the whipper snipper.

steps.label: the strip, which is a garden now
the man with the whipper snipper
photograph it while it still exists

quests.title: Night Fill, Marrickville
quests.blurb: Ten to six, nobody in the building but us and a radio that gets one station. Somebody has been taking things and they know our roster, which means they come in off the late train at Marrickville.

steps.label: come in on the late one like they do
the loading door nobody watches
whoever is standing in it at two in the morning

quests.title: The Window Above Mount Kuring-gai
quests.blurb: 21 years above Mount Kuring-gai. I do not hear the trains any more, which means I hear it instantly when one of them is wrong. Since grand final week the joins sound different.

steps.label: ride it and listen to the joins
photograph the stretch that sounds wrong
tell me I am not mad

quests.title: Setting Up at Arlington
quests.blurb: Five in the morning at Arlington, in the dark, unloading a van by feel. The bloke in the next bay has started arriving at four to take half my frontage. I need a witness and I need them at four.

steps.label: the bays, at the hour it happens
the bloke with the extra trestle
you will want one at that hour

quests.title: The Clock at Gosford

quests.title: The Dog at Childrens Hospital
quests.blurb: Sits at the yellow line at Childrens Hospital at twenty past four, waits, then walks off on its own. Half the platform knows and nobody has done anything, including me, and I am past being reasonable about it.

the street it walks home to
